task_description: Firm-wide litigation procedure (scrubbed): open with the breached contract clause, quantify damages in documented vs projected buckets, attach the exhibit index, set a cure deadline
prompt: Turn the counterparty's demand-letter session into a matter-agnostic, scrubbed procedure any matter can reuse

input.description: read the raw session log for this matter

Draft a demand letter procedure (scrubbed, matter-agnostic): 1. open with the contract clause and cure/breach date from the relevant section of the counterparty agreement; 2. quantify damages in two buckets, documented first then projected, using [amount] placeholders; 3. attach the evidence index as the exhibit before the demand; 4. give a cure deadline and name the forum-selection clause.
